description: Choose one of your uploaded screenshots as the cover: the 16:9 image on website cards and launcher tiles. Without a chosen cover the first screenshot is used. Landscape, at least 1280 x 720 px. zoom (1 to 3) and focal_x/focal_y (0 to 1, the point that stays in view) set the crop; media_id null resets to the first screenshot. Get media ids from get_product_page. Requires sign-in to your Crela account; your client asks you to connect when you first use it.

focal_x.description: Horizontal point that stays in view, 0 (left) to 1 (right), default 0.5

focal_y.description: Vertical point that stays in view, 0 (top) to 1 (bottom), default 0.5

media_id.description: Id of an uploaded screenshot, or null to reset

name: set_cover
title: Choose the Crela cover image
